common.fairness: within every algorithm and seed, Full and its one ablation replay the exact same workload universe, source-worker/GPU fault probes, topology, physical capacity and path parameters

s4.purpose: mechanism-targeted single-factor ablations; each panel registers an algorithm-specific mechanism metric and still reports healthy and fault-conditioned WCT

algorithm1.residual_dag: four visible parallel agent branches joining at one sink
algorithm1.slack_formula: max_branch_predicted_service_ms - branch_predicted_service_ms using frozen model coefficients and offered-load slowdown; no realized output/service
target_metrics: critical-branch fraction of Peer-HBM copy bytes
copy bytes by critical/medium/high slack class
healthy and worker-fault mean/p99 WCT with paired seed CI
algorithm1.success_gate: causal slack has at least three distinct values; Full records nonzero slack and the ablation records zero slack

algorithm2.capacity_rule: all four classes keep the same 40-GiB physical target, 10-GiB initial Peer-HBM quota and 64-GiB DRAM pool; the mask represents nonpositive recovery benefit or route eligibility, not a capacity change
algorithm2.ablation_rule: coupled all-or-nothing admission accepts both-benefit only when both tiers fit and fail-closes a one-tier benefit; it keeps the same controller, copies, capacity and AIMD
target_metrics: residency fraction by preregistered benefit class
healthy and worker-fault WCT with paired seed CI
algorithm2.success_gate: Full covers the four exact class outcomes in every seed; ablation emits only HBM_AND_DRAM or BYPASS

target_metrics: pressure/stable windows, quota, reclaim and post-control dispatch
healthy and worker-fault mean/p99 WCT with paired seed CI
algorithm3.success_gate: Full executes all 14 per-target control windows; ablation schedules the same opportunities and executes zero alpha updates

s4.paired_ci: paired seed-level t interval with df=2

s5.purpose: test additive recovery after an analytically bounded offered-load drop, without searching recovery loads

analytic_bound.capacity_safe_active_requests_formula: floor((shared budget - 0.30 * 40 GiB) / request p99 serving bytes)
analytic_bound.guard_rule: use one offered active request per GPU, leaving one request of concurrency guard below both the capacity-safe ceiling and controller active>2 threshold

s5.schedule: same frozen low C1 0-90s, high C8 90-180s, recovery C1 180-420s used by the Algorithm-3 pair
s5.coverage_rationale: eight recovery windows cover two complete K=3 stable-window cycles plus two guard windows
s5.behavior_gate: each seed must show a high-phase alpha decrease, at least one target-stable recovery observation, and at least one recovery-phase increase in mean alpha; otherwise publish FAIL_DIAGNOSTIC and inspect target pressure trace
s5.occupancy_fields: event-state serving HBM, physical-target Peer-HBM backup and Store DRAM at each control window; no event-fraction inference

evidence_boundary: Three-seed mechanism-targeted preliminary DES. Workload roles, tier-benefit classes, capacity equation and schedule are preregistered without win thresholds. Directional bandwidth, service and failover remain modeled/unmeasured.
